title: AgentChat ChainLit sample to display name of agents in teams
body:
### What feature would you like to be added?

Kindly provision for adding names of agents displaying messages in chainlit sample 
https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/a0e3a1208cddf9e6f74f2596a492f65ac5213995/python/samples/agentchat_chainlit/README.md#L4

### Why is this needed?

For clarity on which agent is sharing the message. Currently just messages going back and forth , no clarity on name of agent communicating in chat
